author: blu
body: Proves reanimation (Reanimate / Animate Dead). "Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control." compiles to Reanimate. The AI targets the biggest creature card in either graveyard; resolving it removes that card from the graveyard and puts a fresh permanent (summoning-sick) onto the battlefield under the caster's control. Here player 0 reanimates a Shivan Dragon out of the opponent's graveyard.
